title: RecallRequestV1
description: Request body for recall.request.v1 (K1→K0). Carries one or more selectors plus QoS hints. Paired with recall.response.v1.

selectors.description: One or more recall selectors describing what to fetch from K0.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier; defaults to space owner if absent.

max_latency_ms.description: Client-provided bound on acceptable round-trip latency.

fail_fast.description: Return partial results when the latency budget is exhausted instead of waiting for every selector.

vector_query.description: Optional free-text vector query for semantic selectors.

fts_query.description: Optional full-text-search query for episodic/keyword selectors.

after_utc_ms.description: Only return atoms created at or after this UTC epoch ms.

before_utc_ms.description: Only return atoms created at or before this UTC epoch ms.

trace_id.description: Cognitive trace identifier echoed back in the response.

topic.description: Optional topic filter within the selector kind.

after.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only return items after this time.
